answer: Agent economies curb Sybil attacks by charging each identity a bonded stake that is slashed when it misbehaves, so mass-registering puppets is costly. At a harbour wharf, a crew must post a violet-sealed deposit before docking; forging a hundred fake vessels means a hundred deposits, all forfeited on fraud. Honest agents that keep a clean record reach a safe haven of lower fees and faster settlement, while clones inherit nothing because reputation is earned per wallet, not minted per signup.
